Rashi on Beitzah 15b:1:1.hebrew: יום טוב לא יבשל בתחלה - שלא להיות תחלת בשולו ועיקרו לשם שבת, אלא לשם יו"ט יהא תחלת בשולו, והמשויר יהא לשבת, כדקתני ואזיל. "אבל מבשל הוא ליו"ט" - ובלא הערמה, כדקתני לקמן:
Rashi on Beitzah 15b:1:1.english: A Festival [that occurs on Shabbat eve], one may not cook initially - [One may not cook] such that the beginning of the cooking and its main purpose is for the sake of Shabbat. Rather, the beginning of the cooking should be for the sake of the Festival, and what is left over will be for Shabbat, as it teaches as it continues: "However, he may cook for the Festival" — and without subterfuge, as it teaches below:

Rashi on Beitzah 15b:1:2.english: He prepares a cooked dish - For the sake of the eiruv.

Rashi on Beitzah 15b:2:1.hebrew: וביצה שעליו - שהיו טחין ביצה על הדג כשצולין אותו:
Rashi on Beitzah 15b:2:1.english: And the egg that is on it - For they would smear an egg on the fish when roasting it.
